title: Privacy Policy
description: How {{COMPANY_NAME}} collects, uses and protects your personal information.
body:
This policy explains what personal information {{COMPANY_FULL_NAME}} ("we", "us") collects when you use {{SITE_URL}}, why we collect it and what your rights are. We are the data controller for this information under UK data protection law (UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018).

## 1. What we collect

Contact details you give us, such as your name, email address and phone number.

Information about your studies and plans, such as your qualifications, the subjects and courses you are interested in, and where you would like to study.

Messages you send us, including your conversations with our course finder chat and any summary of them we keep with your enquiry.

Booking details if you book a consultation, such as the date and time you choose.

Basic technical information, such as your IP address and browser type, which our hosting provider records to keep the site secure and working.

Please don't share sensitive information, such as health details, in the chat unless it is relevant to your course choice.

## 2. How we use it

To answer your questions and recommend courses and universities that suit you.

To contact you, arrange consultations and help you apply, if you ask us to.

To keep the website secure and improve our service.

## 3. Our legal basis

We use your information because you have asked us to help you (steps taken at your request before entering into an agreement), because we have a legitimate interest in responding to enquiries and running our service, or because you have given consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

## 4. Who we share it with

We never sell your information.

We use trusted service providers who process information on our behalf: Vercel (website hosting), Anthropic (powers the course finder chat), HubSpot (stores enquiries) and Cal.com (consultation booking).

We only share your details with a university when you ask us to help you apply there.

Some of these providers are based outside the UK, mainly in the United States. Where this happens, your information is protected by approved safeguards, such as the UK Extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the UK International Data Transfer Agreement.

## 5. How long we keep it

We keep enquiry and contact information for up to 2 years after we last hear from you, then delete it, unless you ask us to delete it sooner or we need to keep it longer by law.

## 6. Your rights

You have the right to ask for a copy of your information, to have it corrected or deleted, to restrict or object to how we use it, and to receive it in a portable format. Where we rely on consent, you can withdraw it at any time.

To make a request, email us at {{COMPANY_EMAIL}}. We will reply within one month.

## 7. Young people

Our service is aimed at people aged 16 and over. If you are under 16, please ask a parent or guardian before contacting us.

## 8. Complaints

If you are unhappy with how we handle your information, please contact us first. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk or on 0303 123 1113.

## 9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
